help_q1: How do I start a group?
help_q1_a: Open Chats, tap the group icon and choose a name and members.
help_q2: How do I change the language?
help_q2_a: Use the language switcher in Settings > Language. The whole app switches between Arabic and English instantly.
help_q3: Why is a message not sending?
help_q3_a: Check your connection. Failed messages show a red icon; tap it to retry.
